content: Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD) and Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH) are conditions that can occur in individuals without significant alcohol consumption. The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends cost-effective screening methods for these liver conditions. One such method involves the use of the FIB-4 index, which is a non-invasive scoring system. The FIB-4 score is determined using a formula that incorporates the patient’s age, levels of alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST), as well as the platelet count.
